card.name: Fixed phrases: 'or' before operating machinery
card.fires_on: The word 'or' in stock label phrases, mainly 'driving a car or operating machinery' and 'contact the company at [phone] or FDA at'. It also fires on 'not' in 'may not necessarily occur' and on digits inside citation page numbers or DOIs.

modes.label: Driving or machinery
modes.description: 'or' joining 'driving a car/motor vehicle' to 'operating machinery' in hazardous-activity warnings.
modes.example: such as driving a car<< or>> operating machinery. Warn patients not to drive

modes.label: Phone number or FDA
modes.description: 'or' after the company phone number in the adverse-reaction reporting line, before 'FDA at'.
modes.example: contact Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC at 1-800-551-7176<< or>> FDA at 1-8

modes.label: Citation digits
modes.description: A digit or word part inside journal citations, page ranges or DOIs.
